question: Where was the first-ever national conference of Urban Local Body Chairpersons across Indian States and UTs inaugurated by the Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla in July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gurugram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first-ever national conference of **Urban Local Body Chairpersons** across Indian States and Union Territories was inaugurated by **Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla** in **July 2025**.
 
• The conference was held in **Gurugram, Haryana**, emphasizing the importance of urban governance and decentralized administration.
 
• The aim of the conference was to provide a platform for **Urban Local Body (ULB) leaders** to share ideas, experiences, and best practices for improving urban management.
 
• The event highlighted the role of ULBs in implementing **flagship government schemes** and addressing challenges such as urbanization, infrastructure development, waste management, and public services.
 
• Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla stressed the need for **strengthening local governance** and ensuring active participation of citizens in urban decision-making processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Urban Local Bodies (ULBs):**

 
 
• ULBs are local government institutions responsible for managing urban areas such as cities and towns.
 
• They include municipal corporations, municipal councils, and town panchayats.
 
• ULBs play a key role in implementing policies related to **urban infrastructure**, sanitation, housing, transport, and public health.
 
• The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act provides the framework for the functioning of Urban Local Bodies in India.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Decentralized Governance:**
 
 
• Decentralized governance ensures **efficient delivery** of services and empowers local communities to actively participate in decision-making.
 
• It promotes accountability and transparency in the administration of urban areas.
 
• Decentralization strengthens the role of local leaders in addressing specific urban challenges such as **traffic congestion** and waste management.
 
 
 
• **Urbanization in India:**
 
 
• India is experiencing rapid urbanization, with **more than 34% of the population** living in urban areas as of 2021.
 
• Urbanization presents challenges such as **housing shortages**, pollution, and increased demand for basic services.
 
• Government schemes like **Smart Cities Mission** aim to address these challenges by modernizing urban infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Flagship Government Programs:**
 
 
• Programs such as **Swachh Bharat Mission**, **Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT)**, and **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana** aim to improve urban living conditions.
 
• ULBs play a pivotal role in implementing these initiatives and ensuring their success.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Role of Lok Sabha Speaker:**

 
 
• Shri Om Birla, as the Speaker of Lok Sabha, has been actively involved in initiatives to strengthen democratic institutions and governance at all levels.
 
• His participation in the conference underscores the importance of local governance in India's democratic framework.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Gurugram:**
 
 
• Gurugram is one of India's leading urban centers, known for its rapid development and modern infrastructure.
 
• The city serves as a hub for discussions on urban challenges and solutions, making it a fitting location for the conference.
